card.name: Dose equivalents in tablet counts
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a strength or amount, where a dose is restated as a number of tablets or a rate (e.g. 'eight 120 mg tablets', 'per meal', 'per minute').

modes.label: Tablet-count equivalents
modes.description: Gap after a count of tablets, just before the per-tablet strength.
modes.example: or eight<< >>120 mg tablets) orally once

modes.label: Per-unit rates
modes.description: Small word or word ending inside an amount-per-time or per-meal phrase.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words meaning 'average' or 'per' and rates, such as 平均每 and 单价.
card.plain: It fires where a dose is spelled out as a number of tablets or an amount per unit.
